8 Gifts That Evoke the Simple Pleasures of Paper

Whether you’re writing a note or flipping through pages, all offer the indulgence of a screen break

By

There’s a reason many still send season’s greetings in the mail: Too much tech can feel antithetical to the coziness sought during the holidays. Paper in any form can conjure slower, simpler times. In certain forms, it can be even more luxurious. From personalized stationery to a wax letter seal, these stylish, functional and surprising gifts are a reminder of that.
